entities.name: Registration procedure over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Registration procedure performed separately for non-3GPP access. Requires access stratum connection establishment before initiation. Allocates registration area associated with single TAI.

entities.name: UE-initiated service request procedure via non-3GPP access
entities.description: Service request procedure initiated by UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state and 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access when access stratum connection is established.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED state
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5GMM mode where UE is idle and not actively communicating.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message used for registration procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message used for service request procedure.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message used for control plane service request procedure.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session IE
entities.description: Information element that shall not be included in messages sent over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Paging restriction IE
entities.description: Information element that shall not be included in messages sent over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Access stratum connection established
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate successful establishment of access stratum connection.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection established
entities.description: Property indicating that N1 NAS signalling connection is established when access stratum connection is successfully established.

entities.name: AMF maintains paging restriction preferences
entities.description: Property that AMF shall not delete stored paging restriction preferences and shall not stop restricting paging when receiving messages over non-3GPP access.

relations.description: Registration procedure over non-3GPP access requires access stratum connection to be established first.
Service request procedure via non-3GPP access requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Service request procedure via non-3GPP access requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Service request procedure via non-3GPP access requires access stratum connection to be established.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message shall not contain Allowed PDU session IE when sent over non-3GPP access.
SERVICE REQUEST message shall not contain Allowed PDU session IE when sent over non-3GPP access.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message shall not contain Paging restriction IE when sent over non-3GPP access.
SERVICE REQUEST message shall not contain Paging restriction IE when sent over non-3GPP access.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message shall not contain Paging restriction IE when sent over non-3GPP access.
When access stratum connection is established, N1 NAS signalling connection is considered established.
When receiving REGISTRATION REQUEST message over non-3GPP access, AMF shall not delete stored paging restriction preferences and shall not stop restricting paging.
When receiving SERVICE REQUEST message over non-3GPP access, AMF shall not delete stored paging restriction preferences and shall not stop restricting paging.
When receiving CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message over non-3GPP access, AMF shall not delete stored paging restriction preferences and shall not stop restricting paging.
